params.val: the holder's next Electric-type move deals double power
the incoming hit did not deal damage

CORRECTED condition type on_hit -> on_hit_holder: this triggers when the HOLDER is hit by a damaging move (Showdown's onDamagingHit, a defensive/target-side hook), not when the holder's own move hits -- on_hit was the wrong direction. Applies to any damaging hit regardless of contact or the incoming move's type (verified against Showdown data/abilities.ts: electromorphosis). Consumed by using that next Electric move, not a turn countdown -- grants the same 'charge' volatile as the move Charge.
